source.check: Votes as printed; 216-210=6. Citation restored to the original page (6 Nov 2026): the 5 Nov re-citation pointed to an unrelated item; the original page OCR is poor.

note: Triennial election of the seventeen electoral divisions of Kilkeel rural district, one member each, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. Two divisions were contested, Ballymartin and Glassdrumman; the other fifteen were returned unopposed (Newry Telegraph, 21 May 1955, p. 3). O'Reilly was the retiring member.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of Irish News, 3 June 1955, p. 1 (council-audit, Nov 2026): Name_As_Printed Cecil O. Newell -> Mr. Cecil O. Newall (U.) as printed; the name is kept as Newell, the form the other Kilkeel returns print.
